faq.title: Questions before your demo
faq.ctaText: See what you get, which information is available and what happens next.
faq.q10: Where can I find a database of companies in Belgium?
faq.a10: The CBE is an official source of Belgian company data. The BelgoBase company database combines available CBE and NBB data for selection by industry, NACE-BEL activity, region and size in FTE. Check the criteria and results, then build a company list with your chosen columns for Excel. Not every field is available for every company.
faq.q11: How can I look up a company by name?
faq.a11: Use Find a company on this website to look up one Belgian legal entity at a time for free, by name or enterprise number. Choose the right company and view its available basic data and financial figures. This public lookup does not provide bulk selection or Excel export; those features are available in the licensed BelgoBase workspace.
faq.q12: Where can I find company figures?
faq.a12: You can consult filed annual accounts at the Central Balance Sheet Office of the National Bank of Belgium. BelgoBase shows available NBB financial figures alongside CBE company data. Check the financial year and missing data: not every company publishes turnover or the same figures. A missing value does not mean zero.
faq.q13: How can I check a company?
faq.a13: First verify the company’s identity using its name and enterprise number. Then review its available CBE status, activities and addresses and, where available, its NBB figures and their financial year. This helps you assess whether the company fits your target audience. These data do not guarantee creditworthiness or a sale.
faq.q1: Must I start researching again for every new target market?
faq.a1: You do not need to translate your experience into individual filters every time. Discuss your offer in BelgoBase, review the proposed criteria and then research the selection.
faq.q2: Does the value in my old customer lists go to waste?
faq.a2: Your existing knowledge can provide context. Temporary Excel or CSV uploads support 5,000 rows and 4 MB, with files retained for at most seven days. Contact rows are not sent to the AI.
faq.q3: Does my team need to learn all those filters?
faq.a3: Discuss your target market in everyday language. Workspace keeps the selection visible and lets you refine criteria yourself, without first translating your initial question into filters.
faq.q4: How do I avoid preparing for companies of the wrong size?
faq.a4: Review available KBO data, FTE and NBB information before setting priorities. Not all companies publish every figure; a missing value does not mean zero.
faq.q5: Is there a mandatory subscription on top of the purchase?
faq.a5: No. You will receive an official invoice. The one-time licence costs €2,995 excl. VAT. There is no subscription; AI and contact usage are paid for separately.
faq.q6: Must I explain my entire business in a form each time?
faq.a6: Type or speak and refine your request in a conversation. AI helps formulate proposals you review yourself. These functions use your licence’s separate AI credit.
faq.q7: Must I reorganise my list after downloading it?
faq.a7: Choose the companies and available columns before the Excel export. Take the fields your next step needs rather than sorting through every field afterwards.
faq.q8: What if my calling team finds missing phone numbers again?
faq.a8: Research available contact details before calling. Not every company publishes them. BelgoBase can research missing information but cannot guarantee a phone number for every company.
faq.q9: How may I use the data?
faq.a9: BelgoBase is intended for professional B2B prospecting and analysis. You remain responsible for lawful use of the data; the privacy notice explains how BelgoBase processes data.
